liabilities.note: Total liabilities are not tagged; derived as total liabilities and equity minus total equity (and temporary equity where tagged)

total_debt.note: Noncurrent long-term debt plus current maturities plus short-term borrowings

quality.text: Revenue: not reported under any tag FinScope reads (RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, Revenues, SalesRevenueNet, RevenueFromContractWithCustomerIncludingAssessedTax, SalesRevenueGoodsNet, SalesRevenueServicesNet, RevenuesNetOfInterestExpense).

Cost of revenue: not reported under any tag FinScope reads (CostOfRevenue, CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold, CostOfGoodsSold, CostOfServices, CostOfGoodsAndServiceExcludingDepreciationDepletionAndAmortization).
Gross profit: not reported under any tag FinScope reads (GrossProfit).
Operating income: not reported under any tag FinScope reads (OperatingIncomeLoss).
Research and development: not reported under any tag FinScope reads (ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense, ResearchAndDevelopmentExpenseExcludingAcquiredInProcessCost).
Selling, general and administrative: not reported under any tag FinScope reads (SellingGeneralAndAdministrativeExpense).
Interest expense: not reported under any tag FinScope reads (InterestExpense, InterestExpenseNonoperating, InterestExpenseDebt, InterestAndDebtExpense).

Income before income taxes: not reported under any tag FinScope reads (IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesExtraordinaryItemsNoncontrollingInterest, IncomeLossFromContinuingOperationsBeforeIncomeTaxesMinorityInterestAndIncomeLossFromEquityMethodInvestments).
Income tax expense: not reported under any tag FinScope reads (IncomeTaxExpenseBenefit).
Net income: not reported under any tag FinScope reads (NetIncomeLoss, ProfitLoss).
Diluted EPS (reported): not reported under any tag FinScope reads (EarningsPerShareDiluted, EarningsPerShareBasicAndDiluted).
Diluted weighted-average shares: not reported under any tag FinScope reads (WeightedAverageNumberOfDilutedSharesOutstanding, WeightedAverageNumberOfShareOutstandingBasicAndDiluted).
Operating cash flow: not reported under any tag FinScope reads (NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities, NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivitiesContinuingOperations).
Capital expenditure: not reported under any tag FinScope reads (PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment, PaymentsToAcquireProductiveAssets).
Dividends paid: not reported under any tag FinScope reads (PaymentsOfDividends, PaymentsOfDividendsCommonStock, PaymentsOfOrdinaryDividends).
Share repurchases: not reported under any tag FinScope reads (PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock, PaymentsForRepurchaseOfEquity).
Cash and short-term investments: not reported under any tag FinScope reads (CashCashEquivalentsAndShortTermInvestments).
Total liabilities: FY2025 composed from reported parts. Total liabilities are not tagged; derived as total liabilities and equity minus total equity (and temporary equity where tagged)
Total debt: FY2025 composed from reported parts. Noncurrent long-term debt plus current maturities plus short-term borrowings
